name: Mental Fatigue VAS
concept: Momentary mental fatigue (subjective) — tiredness · difficulty concentrating · energy
instruction: Mark the point closest to how you feel right now.

fatigue.text: How mentally tired are you right now?

concentration.text: How hard is it to concentrate right now?
